title: Irrigation Equipment - Design, Installation and Field Evaluation of Microirrigation Systems - Code of Practice
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies recommendations for the design, installation, performance and procedure for field evaluation of microirrigation systems; including trickle, drip, subsurface, bubbler and spray irrigation systems.
clause_3_terminology: Installation and Field Evaluation of Microirrigation Systems

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
